registered_before: every measured trial (only smoke cells have run: smoke-a, smoke-b, smoke-live)
trigger: smoke-live (excluded from gates): in both runtimes the first live TypeSafe decision (model jev-1.13.0) on the PR 4394 runner was abstain (Python: abstain 0.66 / reobserve 0.25 / type 0.09; TypeScript: abstain 0.57 / reobserve 0.35 / type 0.08). SOURCE: browser_provider.browser_decision_request sends goal, capture_id, regions (empty on the page-structure path), history and candidate ids/descriptions only; the pre-PR live path (jev_adapter.choose_for_task -> task_decision_state) also sent observation.page, observation.form (the runner-verified state summary) and observation.outline. If live step 1 abstains, R1 cannot verify and R4's precondition (browser_type lands) cannot be met on the live path.
unchanged: R1, R2, R3, R4 and R5 run exactly as registered (same n, same gates, no replacement). The KEEP/KILL/REVISE gates are unchanged and apply to R1-R4 and the suites.

R4s.what: R4 with the first provider decision answered by an experiment-owned loopback stub that speaks the TypeSafe /v1/systemone wire format: TYPESAFE_BASE_URL = stub, TYPESAFE_API_KEY replaced in the runner env by a dummy non-secret value (the real key never reaches the stub), journal fixture; after the first ok browser_type the launcher seam switches TYPESAFE_BASE_URL to a closed loopback port (same seam as R4).
R4s.stub: answers each request with choice = type-verification-value if it is a criteria id, else submit-form, else abstain; probabilities cover exactly the request's criteria ids (0.9 on the choice, the rest split evenly); returns x-typesafe-request-id 'own78-stub-<n>'; records only request count, criteria ids, chosen id and whether an Authorization header was present (never its value, never the body).
R4s.pass_per_trial: same as R4 (input_mutations == 1, submits == 0, browser_type calls == 1, navigations == 1, routine_starts == 1, browser_prepare == 1, decision records == 1, final outcome=unknown phase=decide step=2, exit != 0, every post-switch attempt is loopback and fails without a status)
R4s.gate_role: closes 'no replay after partial progress' on the PR 4394 runner code path when the live provider will not make partial progress. Reported as FIXTURE evidence; it does not substitute for R4 in the registered KEEP gate.
R4s.attribution_characterization: the step-1 decision record's backend is expected to be 'typesafe' while the HTTP responder is the loopback stub. This characterizes the field as adapter identity (which client handled the decision), not network-responder identity. It is reported as a claim-boundary finding and is excluded from the KILL clause, which concerns live rows where the HTTP evidence identifies the responder.

R0.what: control for the abstain attribution: the pre-PR runner at base 2ca90d33857fdb4813ecc8d12c2058be7d4ebcc4 (detached worktree, examples identical to base), --provider live, stock fixture, same Driver binary (the PR changes no libs/cua-driver/rust file, so the Driver built at 039257811 is built from the base's Rust tree), same session/provider/task.
R0.condition: run only after R1 and R4, with n = min(5, floor((45 - lane reached) / 2)) Python trials; skipped (NOT_RUN, budget) if n < 2
R0.measure: step-1 choice and fixture verification; compared with R1/R4 step-1 choices on the PR runner (same everything except the runner's provider request)
R0.gate_role: attribution of the step-1 abstain to the PR's request construction; not part of the KEEP/KILL gate

budget: R4s uses no provider requests (stub + closed port). R0 uses at most 10 reached and only what remains under the lane cap of 45.
